<style>
    /* Hallmark · theme: brand · scope: app · redesign: full · copy: verbatim research facts and generated history; headings regrouped · built: existing DADS research page */
    /* Hallmark · pre-emit critique: P4 H4 E4 S4 R4 V4 · weakest: H, current results buried below background; moved them first */
    /* The existing research facts, generated history and synchronizer markers remain authoritative. */
    :root {
      color-scheme:light;
      --ink:#182338; --muted:#526078; --blue:#0017c1; --line:#d4dce7;
      --paper:#fdfdff; --surface:#f3f6fb; --pale:#eef3ff;
      --focus:#fff2a8; --width:1184px;
      --body-font:"Noto Sans JP","Yu Gothic",Meiryo,sans-serif;
      --code-font:Consolas,monospace;
    }
    * { box-sizing:border-box; }
    html { scroll-behavior:smooth; scroll-padding-top:28px; overflow-x:clip; }
    body { margin:0; background:var(--paper); color:var(--ink); font-family:var(--body-font); font-size:17px; line-height:1.85; overflow-wrap:anywhere; overflow-x:clip; }
    ::selection { background:var(--focus); color:var(--ink); }
    a { color:var(--blue); text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:.22em; }
    a:hover { text-decoration-thickness:2px; }
    a:active,summary:active,button:active { background:var(--pale); }
    :focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--blue); outline-offset:4px; background-color:var(--focus); }
    [aria-disabled="true"],:disabled { color:var(--muted); cursor:default; }
    .header-inner,.hero-inner,.section-inner,.footer-inner,[data-choice-current="top"],#choice-current-hold { width:min(var(--width),calc(100% - 96px)); margin-inline:auto; }
    .site-header { border-top:4px solid var(--blue); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); }
    .header-inner { padding-block:20px; display:flex; gap:24px; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; }
    .brand { font-size:17px; font-weight:700; color:var(--ink); text-decoration:none; white-space:nowrap; }
    .site-nav { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px 20px; font-size:14px; }
    .site-nav a { color:var(--muted); text-decoration:none; padding-block:8px; }
    .site-nav a:hover,.site-nav a[aria-current] { color:var(--blue); text-decoration:underline; text-decoration-thickness:2px; }
    .hero { background:var(--surface); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); }
    .hero-inner { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr); gap:8px 48px; padding-block:32px; align-items:center; }
    h1,h2,h3,h4 { overflow-wrap:break-word; min-width:0; text-wrap:balance; }
    h1 { grid-row:1 / 3; margin:0; font-size:clamp(28px,3.4vw,40px); font-weight:700; line-height:1.5; letter-spacing:0; }
    .snapshot { color:var(--muted); font-size:14px; margin:0; align-self:end; }
    .lead { font-size:16px; margin:0; align-self:start; }
    h2 { margin:0 0 24px; font-size:clamp(23px,2.3vw,29px); line-height:1.55; }
    h3 { margin:32px 0 16px; font-size:21px; line-height:1.6; }
    h4 { margin:24px 0 12px; font-size:18px; }
    p { margin:0 0 20px; max-width:72ch; }
    section { padding-block:40px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); }
    [data-choice-current="top"] { margin-block:28px 0; padding:20px 24px; background:var(--pale); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:4px; }
    [data-choice-current="top"] p { margin:0; max-width:none; font-size:16px; }
    #current-experiment { padding-top:32px; }
    #current-experiment .table-wrap { margin-block:24px; }
    #current-experiment tbody th { font-family:var(--code-font); white-space:nowrap; font-weight:600; }
    #current-experiment td:nth-last-child(-n+3) { font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
    #current-experiment td:nth-child(6) { font-weight:700; color:var(--blue); }
    #conditions,#overview,#static-dynamic,#results,#audit,#terms { background:var(--surface); }
    .important { padding:20px; border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--pale); }
    .table-wrap { overflow-x:auto; margin:20px 0 24px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:4px; }
    table { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; text-align:left; font-size:15px; line-height:1.8; }
    th,td { padding:16px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); vertical-align:top; }
    thead th { background:var(--surface); font-size:14px; font-weight:700; }
    tbody th { width:27%; font-weight:600; }
    .comparison-table { table-layout:fixed; }
    .comparison-table tbody th { width:auto; }
    #progress .comparison-table th:first-child { width:17%; }
    #progress .comparison-table th:nth-child(4) { width:13%; }
    #progress .comparison-table th:nth-child(5) { width:27%; }
    #current-experiment .comparison-table th:first-child { width:14%; }
    #current-experiment .comparison-table th:nth-child(2) { width:17%; }
    #current-experiment .comparison-table th:nth-child(5) { width:9%; }
    tbody tr:last-child>* { border-bottom:0; }
    tbody tr:nth-child(even) { background:var(--surface); }
    ul,ol { padding-left:1.5em; margin:16px 0 24px; }
    li { margin-block:12px; max-width:76ch; }
    .flow { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:24px; padding-left:24px; }
    .flow li { padding:12px 12px 12px 4px; border-bottom:2px solid var(--line); }
    .flow strong,.flow span { display:block; }
    .flow span { font-size:15px; margin-top:8px; }
    details { border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); padding-block:4px; }
    summary { cursor:pointer; padding:16px 8px; font-size:16px; line-height:1.8; }
    summary:hover { background:var(--pale); }
    details[open]>summary { font-weight:700; }
    summary h4 { display:inline; font:inherit; }
    .condition-detail,.background-detail { margin-block:16px; border-top:1px solid var(--line); }
    .condition-detail+.condition-detail { margin-top:-16px; border-top:0; }
    .condition-detail .table-wrap,.background-detail .table-wrap { margin-top:12px; }
    details>p,details>ul { margin:16px 20px 24px; }
    #progress-log details>ul { padding-left:1.3em; }
    #progress-log li { padding-bottom:16px; margin-bottom:16px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); font-size:16px; }
    #progress-log li:last-child { border-bottom:0; }
    #progress-log summary { font-size:15px; }
    #progress-log time { display:block; margin-bottom:4px; color:var(--ink); font-size:17px; font-weight:700; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
    #choice-current-hold { padding-block:28px; }
    #choice-current-hold h2 { font-size:21px; margin-bottom:12px; }
    code { font-family:var(--code-font); font-size:.9em; }
    .site-footer { background:var(--surface); border-top:1px solid var(--line); }
    .footer-inner { padding-block:28px; font-size:14px; }
    .footer-inner p { margin-bottom:12px; }
    .skip-link { position:absolute; top:8px; left:8px; transform:translateY(-180%); background:var(--focus); padding:8px 16px; z-index:100; }
    .skip-link:focus { transform:none; }
    .back-to-top { position:fixed; right:20px; bottom:20px; border:1px solid var(--blue); border-radius:4px; background:var(--paper); color:var(--blue); font:inherit; padding:8px 16px; visibility:hidden; }
    .back-to-top.is-visible { visibility:visible; }
    a.local-only { color:var(--muted); text-decoration:none; }
    @media(max-width:900px) {
      .header-inner { align-items:flex-start; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; }
      .header-inner,.hero-inner,.section-inner,.footer-inner,[data-choice-current="top"],#choice-current-hold { width:calc(100% - 48px); }
      .site-nav { gap:4px 20px; }
      #current-experiment .comparison-table th:first-child { width:16%; }
      th,td { padding:12px; }
    }
    @media(max-width:700px) {
      body { font-size:16px; }
      .header-inner,.hero-inner,.section-inner,.footer-inner,[data-choice-current="top"],#choice-current-hold { width:calc(100% - 32px); }
      .header-inner { padding-block:12px; }
      .site-nav { font-size:13px; gap:0 16px; }
      .hero-inner { display:block; padding-block:24px; }
      h1 { font-size:28px; } .snapshot { margin-top:12px; } .lead { margin-top:12px; font-size:15px; }
      section { padding-block:28px; } h2 { margin-bottom:20px; } h3 { font-size:19px; }
      [data-choice-current="top"] { padding:16px; margin-top:20px; }
      [data-choice-current="top"] p { font-size:15px; }
      .comparison-table { display:block; table-layout:auto; }
      .comparison-table thead { position:absolute; width:1px; height:1px; padding:0; overflow:hidden; clip-path:inset(50%); }
      .comparison-table tbody { display:block; }
      .comparison-table tr { display:block; padding:12px 16px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); }
      .comparison-table tbody tr:last-child { border-bottom:0; }
      .comparison-table tbody th { display:block; width:auto; padding:4px 0 12px; font-size:16px; }
      .comparison-table td { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.6fr); gap:12px; padding:8px 0; border:0; }
      #current-experiment .comparison-table tbody th,#progress .comparison-table tbody th { width:auto; border:0; }
      .comparison-table td::before { content:attr(data-label); color:var(--muted); font-size:13px; font-weight:500; }
      #progress .comparison-table td { display:block; }
      #progress .comparison-table td::before { display:block; margin-bottom:2px; }
      .flow { display:block; }
      table { font-size:14px; } th,td { padding:12px 8px; }
      tbody th { width:32%; }
      details>p,details>ul { margin-inline:8px; }
      .back-to-top { right:12px; bottom:12px; font-size:14px; }
    }
    @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { html { scroll-behavior:auto; } }
    @media print { .site-nav,.back-to-top { display:none; } details:not([open])>*:not(summary) { display:block!important; } section { break-inside:auto; } tr { break-inside:avoid; } }
  </style>
script:
<script>
    (() => {
      const topButton = document.querySelector('.back-to-top');
      const navLinks = [...document.querySelectorAll('.site-nav a')];
      const sections = navLinks
        .map((link) => document.querySelector(link.getAttribute('href')))
        .filter(Boolean);
      const isPublicHost = ['http:', 'https:'].includes(window.location.protocol)
        && !['localhost', '127.0.0.1'].includes(window.location.hostname);

      if (isPublicHost) {
        document.querySelectorAll('a[href]').forEach((link) => {
          const href = link.getAttribute('href');
          if (href && !href.startsWith('#') && !/^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:/i.test(href)) {
            link.removeAttribute('href');
            link.classList.add('local-only');
            link.setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
            link.setAttribute('title', 'ローカル正本（公開ページには含まれていません）');
          }
        });
      }

      const updateTopButton = () => {
        topButton.classList.toggle('is-visible', window.scrollY > 700);
      };

      topButton.addEventListener('click', () => window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' }));
      window.addEventListener('scroll', updateTopButton, { passive: true });
      updateTopButton();

      if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
        const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
          const visible = entries
            .filter((entry) => entry.isIntersecting)
            .sort((a, b) => b.intersectionRatio - a.intersectionRatio)[0];
          if (!visible) return;
          navLinks.forEach((link) => {
            const active = link.getAttribute('href') === '#' + visible.target.id;
            if (active) link.setAttribute('aria-current', 'location');
            else link.removeAttribute('aria-current');
          });
        }, { rootMargin: '-20% 0px -68% 0px', threshold: [0, .25, .5] });
        sections.forEach((section) => observer.observe(section));
      }
    })();
  </script>
